speaker: james_burbage
text: God's body. Put your hand on it before you give me a poem. North side. The sill is damp, and the post under it is the one I laid in seventy-six.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am putting my hand on it. It gives. I do not need a poem to feel a sponge. Two inches of knife will tell us the rest, if you mean to spend the knife.

speaker: james_burbage
text: I mean to spend it. There.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Two inches, and it did not meet a sound fibre. Father, that is the ground-post, not a rail a man can swap on a Saturday. Who pays the carpenter?

speaker: james_burbage
text: Who pays. Always who pays. The lease is twenty-one years. I took the ground from Giles Allen, and the ground falls back to Giles Allen on the thirteenth of April in ninety-seven. He is slow to talk of renewing. He is slow as a matter of sport.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A king loses a roof and sends for another king. You will send for a carpenter. The difference is that a king thinks the ground is his by being a king, and you know the ground is Allen's when the years are done.

speaker: james_burbage
text: By the mass. Do not teach me my own lease with a crown on it. I have cursed Allen every third breath since you came through the door, and I will curse him the third breath from now. The post is mine until the ground is not. A rotten post is still my post.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Yours to mend, then, which is the same question in a coat. I am not asking who owns the philosophy of it. I am asking who finds the carpenter his money. Will has not got a price in his mouth. Keep it out of his mouth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no price in my mouth because the timber has not been priced in front of me. I will not invent one to make the morning feel finished. Two mornings in March, in Lent, I will come and hold what a carpenter tells me to hold. The law I leave to the two of you.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Two mornings. Lent. Not a prophecy, Will. I am not asking you to see a new house in a wet post. I am asking you to be here when a man with an adze is here. Easter we are back in Shoreditch. Between now and Easter this north side will not cure itself out of pride.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Easter is the company's return. It is not a bill for oak. Father, if Allen will not talk, the talking can wait for a dry day and a lawyer. The post cannot wait for Allen's manners.

speaker: james_burbage
text: God's body, I know which of them rots faster. Look at the mortise. Wet grass, wet wood, and a knife that went in as if the year seventy-six had been a soft year. It was not a soft year. I raised the posts. I remember the raising. The wood has forgotten.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the wood is the honest one. It remembers rain. I will remember two mornings, and I will not remember a sum I was not told. If you tell me a sum later, I will hear it as news, not as a thing I agreed in a yard.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Agreed. No sum today. Two mornings from you, and the carpenter from us, when we have chosen him. I will not have a player quoted in a quarrel with Allen. Allen would enjoy a player. He would enjoy a player more than a post.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Let him enjoy what he likes. He shall not enjoy my wall off its ground while I can still curse him. Thirteen April, ninety-seven. Say it back to me, so I know you were listening and not composing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The thirteenth of April, fifteen ninety-seven. Twenty-one years, and the ground back to Allen, and Allen slow. Two inches into the post. Two mornings in March. No price. No new building hiding in the sentence.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: That is the whole of it, and it is more than I expected to get without a figure. Father, put the knife away before you demonstrate the next post and we are here till dinner.

speaker: james_burbage
text: The next post can stand. This one is the sermon. Will, you play at two, I suppose, like a man with a trade. Come away from the sill. The grass is wetting your shoes, and Allen shall not have your shoes as well as my ground.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: At two I open a play and then I wait. The waiting I can do. The post I cannot mend with waiting. I will come in March, in the morning, twice. If you need me to say the date again, I can say it on the road, where it costs nothing.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Once was enough. You said it without making it a speech about kings the second time. I noticed. Go and be Egeon. Cuthbert, you and I will not price timber in front of a poet just to feel busy.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: We will not. Who pays the carpenter is still my question, and it is not his. Will, ten of the clock was early enough. You were right not to come at nine to the Keys and pretend this was a rehearsal.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was told ten, and I came at ten. The yard at the Keys can rehearse another morning. This morning was a post. I have seen the post. I am going to play an old man who has lost a wife, and I am not going to hurry him.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Hurry nobody. Least of all a beam. Beams punish a hurry. God's body, I am done cursing for the length of a walk. It will come back before Bishopsgate.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Two mornings, and the date, and no sum. I will write it that way if I write it at all. Father can curse on the walk. I am done with the sill.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are done with the sill. I will see the carpenter in March, and I will not see a price until someone says one out loud.
